definitions.explanation: The punctuation marks ( ) used to enclose supplementary information. The most common type of bracket in Japanese writing.

examples.japanese: {丸括弧|まるかっこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注|ちゅう}→注：03434_chuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put the note inside parentheses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{丸括弧|まるかっこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{示|しめ}されている→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: The reading is shown in parentheses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{丸括弧|まるかっこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{順序|じゅんじょ}→順序：05460_junjo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: In mathematics, parentheses are used to indicate the order of operations.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧ (round, circle) + ⟦{括弧|かっこ}→括弧：00151_kakko⟧ (brackets). The standard term for the round brackets ( ) in Japanese. In everyday speech, people often just say ⟦{括弧|かっこ}→括弧：00151_kakko⟧, which defaults to parentheses unless another type is specified.

JAPANESE BRACKET TYPES:
- {丸括弧|まるかっこ}: parentheses ( )
- ⟦{角括弧|かくかっこ}→角括弧：26050_kakukakko⟧: square brackets [ ]
- ⟦{中括弧|なかかっこ}→中括弧：26051_nakakakko⟧: curly brackets { }
- {山括弧|やまかっこ}: angle brackets < >
- {隅付|すみつ}き⟦{括弧|かっこ}→括弧：00151_kakko⟧: lenticular brackets (thick square brackets used in Japanese typesetting)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丸括弧|まるかっこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to enclose in parentheses
- {丸括弧|まるかっこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to add parentheses
- {丸括弧|まるかっこ}⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧: inside the parentheses

USAGE:
In Japanese text, full-width parentheses are standard. When dictating, people say ⟦{括弧|かっこ}→括弧：00151_kakko⟧ to open and {括弧閉|かっこと}じ to close.
